limits.single_key_custody: one gateway key, no m-of-n threshold, no HSM
limits.mock_bank: no network, no TLS, no KYC/AML/sanctions, no regulator reporting
limits.trusted_refs: idempotency by caller-supplied ref; a real bridge must derive refs from bank-side txn IDs
limits.no_compensation: burn-before-payout uses a custody peek so payout cannot fail after burn; no reversal path
